findings.text: Blank program starts empty: no Customer D name or mission, an unnamed system on the next free code, and element codes taken from the system code typed.
No tailoring is pre-applied on any start; a product program sees the customer decisions as suggestions, each with its own Add that opens Tailor for this program.
A link followed from Lifecycle, Boundary, Host & providers, the workbook or a record page keeps the created program current; only the switcher or a link naming a program changes it.
The SCTM workbook of a created program is an empty state naming it, with its requirement and mapping counts and links to Requirements and Controls.
Host & providers lists the host's controls with the provider's status beside the program's own standing (No requirement); the control and provider previews name the created program.
Each build page has its first action: Create element, Add interconnection, Add port, Tailor a control, Upload policy, Import checklist; each writes a record the page lists.
Composition lists the system and its elements, Baseline the wizard's stack, Controls every control at its standing, Boundary the elements, People the roles.
Lifecycle dates count back from the wizard's target authorization date: the ATO is due on it, earlier steps keep the template's order, scaled to fit; step previews agree.
Categorize and Select read In review, awaiting signature, with the wizard's levels, baseline and date, and Completed once the PM and the AO sign the ITCSC.
The setup guide is read from each program's own records, so two created programs keep their own progress.
Create requirement and Map control, Upload evidence against a requirement, SSP revision 1 narratives and Publish, then Plan assessment; Findings, POA&M, Risks Create and Start package.
Each setup step is done when its record exists (requirements, mappings, evidence, signatures, the published SSP); nothing is ticked by hand and no file drop ticks a step.
Overview, Controls, Programs and Home count the host's inherited controls by the provider's status, as WS-X90's counts do; the inherits card lists them.
The created program's ITCSC is a draft from the wizard (§6, §7, §10, §11) with Sign for the PM and the AO; done only once both sign.
Choosing another created program in the switcher draws it, even at the same address; the switcher and its stage line read the new program.
Each open setup step with an owner is a task in My work, under Setup · the program, linking to the step's page with the program made current.
The setup guide, the Invite placeholder and Import requirements no longer name Customer D or a product a blank program lacks.
findings.why: The invite's error message still cites name@customer-d.mil; the wizard writes it from inside, with no hook V3 can reach.

findings.text: A created program's Overview shows its control status band, its life cycle and the setup card; Getting started and program-start open that one page.
Systems asks the ITCSC §7 national security system question before Continue and applies CNSSI 1253 on Yes; no start preselects a host.
Systems proposes the next free system code and checks it as the program code is checked: a taken code is named and Continue waits.
⌘K search finds created programs by name, program code and system code; the result opens the program's Overview and makes it current.
SP-70's Programs row names its system owner from the wizard, leaves No owner, and opens the program preview like the other rows.
Host & providers offers Add provider for a created program, with or without a host; the added provider's controls join its counts.
A program made from a product keeps the product's inherits card on its Overview, with the rule: inherited counts unchanged claims, satisfied counts determinations, so they differ.

extra.text: A created program's Activity page lists its own events: creation, requirements, evidence, signatures, the published SSP, the planned campaign.
Lifecycle's Select step completes with the ITCSC, the Categorization and Selection Checklist the AO signs, as AF programs record both decisions.
Publishing SSP revision 1 says exactly what it needs: a narrative for each control a requirement maps; Plan assessment waits on it and says so.

walks.title: Create a program, take it to assessment

steps.see: Name and mission are empty, with placeholders; no Customer D anywhere.
steps.v2: Prefilled 'Customer D · X800 Eject Launch Integration'.

steps.do: Name it SP-70, Continue to Systems; read the host and the new national security system question.
steps.see: Host None, system code SYS-2301 marked free, the NSS question required.
steps.v2: No NSS question; a product start preselected F-16.

steps.do: Answer Yes, add elements, then Continue through Baseline, Team and Create program.
steps.see: CNSSI 1253 in the stack; no tailoring decisions until you add one.
steps.v2: Customer D's PE-17 and SR-4 decisions arrived pre-applied.

steps.see: Control status band (inherited satisfied, the rest No requirement), the life cycle, Setup 2 of 9.
steps.v2: A starter guide copy; no control status.

steps.do: Open Lifecycle, then ITCSC from the menu.
steps.see: ATO due Sep 30, 2027; Categorize awaiting signature; ITCSC stays SP-70's.
steps.v2: ATO May 30, 2030; ITCSC link switched to WS-X90.

steps.do: Sign as program manager, then as authorizing official.
steps.see: Both signatures recorded; Lifecycle's Categorize and Select read Completed.
steps.v2: Empty ITCSC page with no action.

steps.do: Create requirement REQ-001 mapped to AC-2, then Upload evidence against it on Evidence.
steps.see: Controls shows AC-2 move to No evidence, then Not assessed.
steps.v2: No Create requirement; evidence left the program.

steps.do: Write AC-2's narrative, then Publish revision 1.
steps.see: Publish says what it needs; publishing opens Assessments.
steps.v2: The SSP page looped back to the starter guide.

steps.see: CMP-001 planned over AC-2; Overview's Setup counts it.
steps.v2: Assessment waited for an SSP nothing could publish.

steps.do: Open Host & providers; preview F-16 Block 70.
steps.see: Each hybrid control reads SP-70's No requirement; the preview says What SP-70 takes.

steps.do: Find SP-70's row on Programs and click it.
steps.see: Owner Marcus Ryde, inherited controls counted, a program preview opens.
steps.v2: Owner '—', 0 of 555, the row left for the program.

steps.see: Setup · SP-70 lists its open steps, each linked to its page.
steps.v2: No guide step reached My work.

steps.see: SP-70 is found; Enter opens its Overview.

steps.do: Create a second program with every default, answering the NSS question.
steps.see: No host preselected, CNSSI 1253 applied, no tailoring.
steps.v2: F-16 preselected, High without CNSSI, Customer D tailoring.

steps.do: Switch back to SP-70 in the switcher.
steps.see: SP-70 draws with its own Setup progress; the second program keeps its own.
steps.v2: The old page stayed drawn; guide progress was shared.

shots.title: A blank wizard's Program step
shots.caption: v2 prefills Customer D's X800 name and mission on a blank program; V3 starts empty, with placeholders.

shots.title: A created program's Composition
shots.caption: v2 says nothing is recorded; V3 lists the system's four elements, codes from SYS-2301, with Create element.

shots.title: A created program's Overview
shots.caption: v2 repeats the starter guide; V3 shows control status (inherited satisfied), Setup read from records, and the life cycle.

shots.title: Lifecycle against the target date
shots.caption: v2 dates the ATO May 30, 2030; V3 dates it on the target, Sep 30, 2027, with Categorize awaiting signature.
